title: How Amazon Marketplace evaluates content quality with Amazon SageMaker AI
summary: Learn how Amazon Marketplace evaluates A+ Content quality at scale on Amazon SageMaker AI by rendering each product page as a single snapshot, scoring it with a vision-language model fused with OCR readability signals in a CatBoost classifier, and using SHAP to turn each decision
reason: Technical case-study blog on Amazon's internal use of SageMaker AI for A+ content scoring. No named model release, no research paper/benchmark, no business event (financing/M&A/partnership/market data), and no open-source tool release. No rule covers it.
